alex (AE): POC blocked: customer POSTed one JSON with ~14MB body to /v1/infer and received 413. Demo tomorrow.
nina (SE): Do they allow hosting the blob internally or presigned URLs?
alex (AE): Security says no external presigns. They can host internally but would need our data plane to fetch it.
tony (runtime eng): Hosted ingress default is 8MB. Logs: ingress: reject: body_size=14.2MB > max_body=8MB.
nina (SE): Short-term options: 1) client chunk + assemble with SDK (needs client changes), 2) internal pointer (we fetch from their internal store), 3) temporary org-scoped ingress increase for the POC (needs security signoff).
tony (runtime eng): Cost note: billing is per-token. Splitting into many calls that re-send long system prompts multiplies those prompt tokens. Pointer + single call is typically cheapest. Also very large single requests increase GPU work per call; for sustained usage recommend Dedicated/Private.
infra-bot: ticket INC-5044 created: "ingress bump request for demo-cust (POC)" assigned to eng-infra.
alex (AE): I'll notify the customer of options and ask if they can provide an internal fetch endpoint. Nina, can you draft the short cost comparison and a chunking snippet?
nina (SE): On it, will post the doc and code here.
